events.title: Scenario: AI compute growth concentrates load on regional substations
events.summary: Clustered AI data-center growth could create localized transformer demand spikes, raising procurement and reliability risk for nearby grids.

events.title: Scenario: Manufacturing retooling and regional capacity shift raises transformer lead times
events.summary: Manufacturing retooling toward higher-spec transformers could reduce near-term availability of standard units, raising lead-time and procurement pressure.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC and converter demand grows with long-distance renewables
events.summary: Expanding long-distance renewable transmission may elevate demand for HVDC converters and specialized transformers, stressing specialized manufacturing and material supply chains.

events.title: Scenario: Aging substations and quicker replacements create procurement competition
events.summary: Accelerated replacements for aging substations may generate regional procurement competition, increasing costs and schedule risk.

events.title: Scenario: Near-term mineral export disruptions increase battery component risk
events.summary: Export disruptions for key minerals could temporarily constrain battery and transformer component production, creating downstream delivery risk.

events.title: Scenario: Regional data-center and renewables convergence drives local transformer scarcity
events.summary: Converging data-center and renewable deployment in regional hubs could precipitate localized transformer shortages and scheduling conflicts.

events.title: Scenario: AI/OT convergence increases cyber-risk considerations at substations
events.summary: Increased AI/OT usage in substation operations could raise cyber-risk and drive resilience-driven retrofit demand.

events.title: Scenario: Load variability and reliability programs increase BESS procurement competition
events.summary: Rising BESS demand for reliability could strain cell and inverter supply, increasing procurement risk and causing staging decisions.

events.title: Scenario: Interconnection and resilience standards prompt accelerated retrofit programs
events.summary: Stronger interconnection/resilience expectations could accelerate retrofit demand, competing with new-build procurement and potentially lengthening lead times.

events.title: Scenario: OEM consolidation signals and procurement concentration
events.summary: OEM consolidation could centralize supply risk and amplify the effects of plant-level disruptions on global equipment availability.
